{{Quote|The main reactor and Hyperdrive generator are down. I think they're stranded.|This pirate to Jiro, informing him about a ship they recently found, and the lifeforms aboard|<ref name="Revival (episode)">{{TCW|Revival (episode)}}</ref>}}
Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], this [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] informed [[Jiro/Legends|Jiro]] that a [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and [[Reactor/Legends|main reactor]] were inactive. A little while later, when it turned out that [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and his brother [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] were on the ship, this pirate, along with Jiro and numerous other pirates, joined them against [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]]. Later on, when the two [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were overpowered by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and Hondo, the remaining pirates reunited with Hondo, and helped him to acquire many valuable goods from the brothers' ship.
